name: 01-size-before
derived: a get_file_size request in the form of FILE_XFER::init_upload in the client's file_xfer.cpp, for a file not yet uploaded

name: 02-offset-beyond
derived: an offset for a file of which the server holds nothing

name: 04-size-after
derived: a get_file_size request in the form of FILE_XFER::init_upload in the client's file_xfer.cpp, for the file just uploaded

name: 05-upload-again
derived: the same request sent a second time, as a client does after a lost reply

name: 06-other-contents
derived: the data and the checksum changed, same file name

name: 07-bad-signature
derived: the first digit of the upload certificate changed

name: 08-other-name
derived: the file name changed, the certificate kept

name: 10-resume-part-1
derived: the request cut after ten bytes of data, as when a connection drops

name: 11-resume-size
derived: a get_file_size request in the form of FILE_XFER::init_upload in the client's file_xfer.cpp, after the interrupted upload

name: 12-resume-part-2
derived: the rest of the data, from offset 10

name: 13-no-data-tag
derived: a request without a file_info or data
